err != nil { return c.Status(http.StatusInternalServerError).JSON(fiber.Map{"error": "Internal server error"}) } clicks = append(clicks, click) } if len(clicks) == 0 { return c.Status(http.StatusNotFound).JSON(fiber.Map{"error": "No clicks found"}) } return c.Status(http.StatusOK).JSON(clicks) } func main() { initDB() defer db.Close() app := fiber.New() app.Post("/click", registerClick) app.Get("/clicks", retrieveClicks) log.Fatal(app.Listen(":5000")) }
